name: Daybreak
rule: Dawn multiplies Focus by 4 instead of 3.

name: Triad
rule: Each beam a Prism emits gains +4 Intensity.

name: Rainbow Tax
rule: At Night end, +1 Glint per distinct beam colour that reached an Aperture that Night (max 7).

name: Secondary School
rule: Yellow, cyan and magenta beams score x1.5 at the Aperture.

name: White Balance
rule: White beams skip colour removal at coloured Apertures.

name: Dispersion
rule: A Splitter struck by white light sends a red and a cyan beam at full Intensity.

name: Full House
rule: If all 7 stones are on the board, that cast's Lux x2.

name: Second Dawn
rule: A second Lens may receive Dawn in the same cast.

name: Monochrome
rule: Lanterns shine red instead of white; weight +1 on Ruby Resonators.

name: Deep Blue
rule: Beams containing blue gain +1 Intensity per empty cell crossed (max +12 per beam).

name: Verdant
rule: Emerald gems have Sympathy +5 instead of +2.

name: Purist
rule: If every gem on the board shares one colour, all gems count one tier higher.

name: Saturation
rule: Weight +1 on Filters.

name: Heat
rule: Weight +1 on Amplifiers struck by light containing red.

name: Cold Light
rule: Splitters give light containing blue three quarters each instead of half.

name: Envy
rule: A Lens firing green light takes the highest Focus any beam has had this cast.

name: Afterglow
rule: Weight +1 on a gem's third strike.

name: Ricochet
rule: Mirrors can be struck one more time.

name: Standing Wave
rule: Each completed loop multiplies a beam's Focus by 1.25.

name: Persistence
rule: A beam passing through a spent gem gains +3 Intensity (max 5 times per beam).

name: Perpetual
rule: All gems can be struck one more time; Lux targets +15%.

name: Feedback
rule: Each Lens may fire twice per cast.

name: Orbit
rule: +1 Glint per completed loop (max 3 per cast).

name: Hall of Mirrors
rule: Mirrors always give Sympathy, whatever the light's colour.

name: Silvering
rule: Mirrors add +3 Intensity per strike.

name: Long Exposure
rule: +1 cast per Night; hand size 4; Lux targets +10%.

name: Kaleidoscope
rule: A beam leaving the board re-enters from the opposite edge once.

name: Long Shot
rule: +1 Intensity per empty cell crossed (max +8 per beam).

name: Tight Setting
rule: A gem next to 2 or more gems adds +2 Intensity per strike.

name: Centerpiece
rule: Weight +1 on the gem in the center cell.

name: Wide Aperture
rule: The Aperture also covers its two neighbouring edge cells.

name: Steady Hand
rule: +1 placement on the second and third casts of each Night.

name: Appraiser
rule: The Lapidary shows 5 gems.

name: Pawnbroker
rule: Sell gems for full price.

name: Interest
rule: At dawn, +1 Glint per 5 held (max +5).

name: Overexpose
rule: Overkill Glints doubled (max +6).

name: Master Cutter
rule: One Recut or Dye free per Lapidary visit.

name: Prospector
rule: Inclusion odds doubled.

name: Lean Pouch
rule: While the pouch holds 14 or fewer gems, hand size +1.

name: Heirloom
rule: Loan 3 Cabinet gems instead of 2.
